name: local state
definition: Per-organism state that only it can read and write.
measured_by: presence of per-entity mutable storage in the substrate spec

name: broadcast state
definition: State any organism can read, written by one or many.
measured_by: a channel readable by non-writers

name: partial observability
definition: Organisms act on less than the full world state.
measured_by: observation function narrower than world state

name: self-location
definition: An organism can determine where it is in the substrate or its own structure.
operationalisations: instruction pointer visible to the genome
measured_by: self-position readable by the organism

name: copy mechanism
definition: A means by which structure is duplicated, whether executed by the organism or by the runner.
measured_by: copy events in telemetry with source and target

name: partial heredity
definition: Descendants inherit some but not all of the parent, or inherit before a copy completes.
measured_by: offspring-parent similarity strictly between 0 and 1 with a declared mechanism
detection_status: UNMEASURED -- no indexed source records offspring-parent similarity as a continuous quantity; the catalogue axes only say whether a copy mechanism exists, so Atlas cannot tell partial heredity from full copying. Needs ATLAS-39.

name: write authority
definition: Who may modify a region: self, neighbour, runner, or environment.
measured_by: write-permission matrix in the substrate spec
detection_status: UNMEASURED -- write permissions live in substrate specs and code, not in any axis the catalogue or the index records. Needs ATLAS-39.

name: resource coupling
definition: Action and persistence cost a conserved or limited quantity.
measured_by: a conserved budget that constrains execution

name: selection pressure
definition: What determines differential persistence or reproduction.
measured_by: the rule that decides who continues

name: memory persistence
definition: Structure that survives an episode, a context reset or a generation.
measured_by: competence retained after a reset with the structure intact

name: communication topology
definition: Who can signal whom, and at what bandwidth.
measured_by: the adjacency over which information can pass

name: temporal gating
definition: An operation is available only after another event, or only in a window.
measured_by: an operator whose availability depends on history
detection_status: UNMEASURED -- operator availability over history is a property of the interpreter, invisible in world/organism/pressure axes. Needs ATLAS-39.

name: reproductive closure
definition: The set of structures needed to produce a descendant is contained in the organism.
measured_by: whether removing the runner's birth step preserves reproduction
detection_status: UNMEASURED -- requires an ablation (remove the runner's birth step) that no indexed experiment reports; presence cannot be read off a description. Needs ATLAS-39.

name: error correction
definition: Machinery that detects or repairs damage to structure or copies.
measured_by: fidelity higher than the raw channel implies
detection_status: UNMEASURED -- needs a measured fidelity and a channel baseline to compare it with; neither is recorded on catalogued systems. Needs ATLAS-39.

name: environmental feedback
definition: Organism action changes the world in ways that change later action.
measured_by: world state dependent on prior organism behaviour

name: competition
definition: Organisms reduce each other's access to persistence or resources.
measured_by: negative interaction terms in outcome

name: niche separation
definition: Sub-populations occupy distinguishable regions with limited mixing.
measured_by: sub-population structure with measurable migration

name: operator composability
definition: Variation or action operators can be combined into larger ones that are themselves inherited or reused.
measured_by: reuse depth greater than one in the dependency graph

name: environment generation
definition: Worlds themselves are produced, mutated or selected rather than fixed.
measured_by: world parameters that change over the run under a rule

name: mutable interpreter
definition: The machinery that executes or copies organisms is itself subject to variation.
measured_by: interpreter state inside the heritable unit
